protocol.cohort: Original 877 complete PartNet cases; exact AnchorTree-initialized shared geometry
protocol.edit: Frozen intended parent local-axis resize, factors 0.8 or 1.25, same tasks and no new generation
protocol.baseline: u_pc = R_p.T (c_c-c_p) / s_p; c_c = c_p + R_p (s_p * u_pc); fixed u, relative rotation, untargeted sizes, root pose; recursive tree decode
protocol.metric: Mean absolute outgoing-edge SAT margin change within object, then mean across objects; original normalized frame fixed
protocol.statistics: Paired object differences baseline minus AnchorTree; numerical differences <=1e-9 treated as zero; category-stratified percentile bootstrap, 10000 replicates, seed 42; win/tie/loss is AnchorTree perspective
protocol.timing: Post-hoc offline control; not a prespecified original experiment
